_comment: Presentation of the forest battlefield; gameplay never reads this. Colours are 0-255, light strengths multiply the art.
ambient: light on the ground far from every source. object_ambient: lowest light on walls and props, so value runs ground < objects < units.
lights.arena: a wide pool over the grid; its radius is a fraction of the grid's longer side so a room of any size is covered.

lights.brazier and lights.crystal: one pool per prop, radius in cells. glow and height (art px) place the bloom above the feet. flicker: share of the strength that moves. spill: colour added to the ground at the source, 0 to 1.
decals: flat ground pictures at a fraction (u, v) of the grid; outside 0..1 lies beyond the grid.
props: lines of standing pictures relative to an edge, so a room of any size gets the scene. Edges: back_left (x < 0), back_right (y < 0), front_left (y >= height), front_right (x >= width).
offset: cells beyond the edge, 0 touches the grid. at: one prop at that fraction along the edge; or from, to and every: a line (beyond 0..1 reaches past the corners).
sprites are cycled along a line. flip mirrors the picture: wall, arch and cliff art faces the back_left edge, so back_right needs flip.
A prop on a front edge rises over the cells behind it. Keep the art height above the feet (px) under (2 * offset + 1) * 16: pillar, brazier, crystal offset 3, wall and cliff offset 4, tree offset 5.
